evidence.reason: The dependency scan's DEPENDENCY_RE omits systemd's StopPropagatedFrom= and PropagatesStopTo= directives. Those are [Unit] dependency directives that can bind a co-installed unit such as ingress.service to crq-tick.service in the stop direction, so ignoring them allows the fence stop to propagate to an active co-tenant. This is an ordinary correctness gap in the existing dependency scan, not a new protection requirement; adding the two alternatives is the smallest compatible fix.
